answer.reason: John's Gospel tells two things Thomas did that set him apart: his offer to die with Jesus and his doubt that gave way to confession.

clauses.english: said he would go and die with Jesus when Jesus set out to Lazarus
clauses.quote: Let us also go, that we may die with him.

clauses.english: refused to believe Jesus had risen until he could touch his wounds, then confessed him "My Lord and my God"
clauses.quote: Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails
